mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which lowers borrowing costs and increases consumer and business spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative during a period of declining FEDFUNDS, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns during a period of rising UNRATE, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP indicates reduced economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows negative growth but the S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth slows and inflation rises, the combination of stagnant growth and rising prices creates a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 growth slows and CPIAUCSL rises but the S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO shows negative growth but the S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is high and the unemployment rate is low, it indicates tight monetary conditions that may lead to reduced borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both FEDFUNDS is high and UNRATE is low but the S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in nonfarm payroll employment suggests labor market weakness, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS shows negative growth but the S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts indicates reduced demand in the housing market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows negative growth but the S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.
